summary: The organization-specific work-board-coord entrypoint selects FS-GG Project 3 without a scope question and applies canonical work-board, its lifecycle contract and pnext-item rather than introducing another scheduler. Execution explicitly permits useful bounded delegation under runtime permissions. The coordinator seeks disjoint Deliveries and preparation/review/evidence work at entry, delivery/blocker changes and hosted waits, accounting actual remaining resources, original reservations and one integrator per shared surface. It resumes existing owners/PRs/attempts, prioritizes acceptance and shared prerequisites, and continues eligible serial work when delegation is unavailable. Supported setup/environment repair remains coordinator-owned within existing authority; missing tooling alone does not prove an external dependency. Sensitive effects, original Unknowns and qualified runtime/admission boundaries remain intact. Success requires full accepted current membership and parent promises; merged source, empty Ready, Done metadata or blocked candidates cannot stand for completion. A genuinely external hold after useful work is exhausted has native suppliers/reopening conditions and a truthful incomplete handoff, with no implied background monitoring. Both instruction roots and discoverable Codex metadata are source-delivered as an operator skill, not materialized into product packages. No publication, installed catalog adoption, live board activation, fleet or efficiency claim follows from this source addition.
title: Project 3 coordinator persists through accepted completion and seeks useful parallel work
